name: TEST 1 — Range (faders)
description: Proves range mapping works. Send any of these addresses with a float 0.0–1.0 and watch the corresponding slider move in huff. Start here.

mappings._section: Send float 0.0–1.0 to each address. Watch the slider move in real time.

mappings.note: EXPECTED: Feedback slider moves. Image smears at high values.
EXPECTED: Corrupt % slider moves. Glitch tiles appear at high values.
EXPECTED: Glitch Alpha slider moves. Tiles fade in/out.
EXPECTED: Base Mix slider moves. Source video appears/disappears.
EXPECTED: Flow Strength slider moves. Image warps at high values.
